server_design.attribution: Explicit reconstructed Server policy, not original limits or prices.
authority: Bind context to owner/current lease/map/NPC interaction admission and expected wallet revision.
Accept only expected step and canonical positive decimalU within policy cap. Ignore all claimed resulting balances.
Single durable transaction moves funds between wallet/bank, conserving total and rejecting insufficient funds/overflow.
Context one-shot operation identity plus receipt prevents repeated C6C from moving funds again; wire has no native nonce.
On commit or refusal read fresh authority, close/replace stale view and send S08 wallet plus freshS44 snapshot. Never reapply historical receiptState.
Disposal closes only its matching context; late cleanup from old runner cannot erase a newer one.
